notes: Pair product: SO-SFP-1000Base-BX10D-34 (Tx/Rx 1310nm/1490nm, footnotes 1) and SO-SFP-1000Base-BX10D-43 (Tx/Rx 1490nm/1310nm, footnote 2). Wavelength rows are model-specific per footnotes 1) and 2). Industrial operating temperature -40°C to +85°C (-I ordering codes); storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Power budget 0 – 13dB. Transmitter output power, receiver minimum input power, and overload are average power (footnote 3). Receiver minimum input power and overload measured @ 1.25Gbps, BER ≤ 1x10-12, PRBS 27-1, back-to-back (footnote 4). Power consumption stated as < 1.0W. Bit rate support stated as 100Mbps to 1.25Gbps.
suggestions: Consider schema fields for power_budget_db, storage_temp_min_c/storage_temp_max_c, and BiDi nominal Tx/Rx wavelength pairs per SKU. temp_min_c/temp_max_c could be list pairs when C-temp and I-temp variants exist.
